description: Draft a reply to one Instagram DM conversation (from dm_threads_list). Waits in Inbox for a person to read and send; nothing is sent by this call, and a new draft replaces the old one. Allowed only while the reply window is open (24 hours after the person's last message), never to someone who replied STOP, and not when they asked for a person. "Automated message · reply STOP to stop, HUMAN for a person" is added unless the text already says how to stop. Up to 1000 bytes in all.

account_id.description: Instagram account the conversation is on (a UUID): from accounts_list

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

text.description: The reply, in the brand's voice

thread_id.description: ID of the conversation: thread_id from dm_threads_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_reply_draft
title: Draft a DM reply
